AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted Main Administrator membership record used for full RBAC verification.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Main Administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was provisioned.

AssistantAdminRecord.title: AssistantAdminRecord
AssistantAdminRecord.description: Trusted Assistant Admin RBAC record managed exclusively by the Main Admin.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Assistant Admin.

fullName.description: Display name of the Assistant Admin.

email.description: Login email address of the Assistant Admin.

createdBy.description: UID of the Main Admin who provisioned this Assistant Admin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when Assistant Admin access was granted.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Member, Assistant Admin, or Main Admin account profile including approval status and summary counters.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

fullName.description: Full display name of the user.

photoAssetId.description: Reference ID in mediaAssets for profile photo, or empty string.

rejectionReason.description: Reason provided by Admin if registration or role access was rejected.

pendingSubmissionsCount.description: Count of official proof submissions currently awaiting review.

totalEarnings.description: Cumulative approved task rewards in BDT.

lastPasswordChangedAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent approved password update, or empty string.

MediaAsset.title: MediaAsset
MediaAsset.description: Isolated binary-encoded compressed image asset for avatars and task proof screenshots.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who uploaded the image.

purpose.description: Intended usage of the image asset.

dataUrl.description: Compressed base64 data URL strictly bounded below 250KB.

sizeBytes.description: Decoded byte length of the image.

TaskItem.title: TaskItem
TaskItem.description: Official freelancing micro-task created and managed exclusively by Main Admin.

instructions.description: Step-by-step instructions for completing the task and capturing proof.

externalLink.description: External destination URL where the member performs the task.

rewardAmount.description: Reward credited upon approval in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT).

isActive.description: Whether the task is visible and open for new member submissions.

createdBy.description: Main Admin UID who created the task.

TaskSubmission.title: TaskSubmission
TaskSubmission.description: Proof screenshot submission by an approved member for an official task.

rewardAmount.description: Verified task reward amount in BDT.

screenshotAssetId.description: MediaAsset ID of the uploaded proof screenshot.

proofLink.description: Optional external proof link shared by member alongside screenshot.

submissionNote.description: Optional note or username proof provided by member.

rejectionReason.description: Required explanation provided when rejecting a submission.

reviewedBy.description: Reviewer UID (Main Admin or Assistant Admin) who reviewed the submission.

reviewedAt.description: ISO timestamp when reviewer completed review.

CustomTaskSubmission.title: CustomTaskSubmission
CustomTaskSubmission.description: Custom work submission outside the official task list with requested BDT amount, Assistant Admin pre-review, and Main Admin final payment approval.

taskName.description: Name/title of the custom work completed.

taskDetails.description: Detailed multiline description of the completed work.

requestedAmount.description: Payment amount requested by the member in BDT.

approvedAmount.description: Final payment amount approved by Main Admin in BDT (0 until approved).

screenshotAssetId.description: Optional MediaAsset ID for uploaded proof screenshot, or empty string.

status.description: Final payment decision status controlled exclusively by Main Admin.

assistantStatus.description: Inspection/recommendation state set by Assistant Admin.

assistantNote.description: Note recorded by Assistant Admin during inspection.

assistantReviewedBy.description: UID of the Assistant Admin who inspected the request.

assistantReviewerId.description: Human-readable ID of the inspecting Assistant Admin.

assistantReviewerName.description: Name of the inspecting Assistant Admin.

assistantReviewedAt.description: ISO timestamp of Assistant Admin inspection.

rejectionReason.description: Required rejection reason provided by Main Admin when rejecting.

reviewedBy.description: Main Admin UID who made the final payment decision.

reviewerId.description: Human-readable ID of the deciding Main Admin.

reviewerName.description: Display name of the deciding Main Admin.

reviewedAt.description: ISO timestamp of Main Admin final payment decision.

transactionId.description: Deterministic ledger transaction ID credited on Main Admin approval, or empty string.

MemberNotification.title: MemberNotification
MemberNotification.description: In-app notification delivered to a member when custom or official task decisions occur.

isRead.description: Whether the member has dismissed/read the notification.

MemberWallet.title: MemberWallet
MemberWallet.description: Atomic wallet ledger balances for an individual member.

userId.description: Owner member UID matching document ID.

totalEarnings.description: Cumulative approved task rewards in BDT.

totalWithdrawals.description: Cumulative paid gross withdrawals in BDT.

totalWithdrawalFees.description: Cumulative paid withdrawal fees in BDT.

reservedWithdrawals.description: Gross withdrawal funds currently reserved in pending requests.

lastWithdrawalId.description: Most recent withdrawal ID used for atomic deduction verification.

lastCreditedSubmissionId.description: Most recent official submission ID used to verify Assistant Admin single-credit invariant.

WalletTransaction.title: WalletTransaction
WalletTransaction.description: Immutable financial ledger record for official task rewards, custom task payments, withdrawals, fees, payouts, and refunds.

transactionId.description: Unique transaction ID (deterministic for task/custom rewards to guarantee zero duplicates).

amount.description: Gross BDT amount associated with the transaction.

feeAmount.description: Fixed withdrawal fee in BDT (5 for withdrawals, 0 otherwise).

netAmount.description: Net BDT amount credited, paid, or refunded.

taskId.description: Associated official taskId recorded on task_reward entries so duplicate submissions remain blocked after approved submission cleanup.

taskCode.description: Human-readable official or custom task code (e.g., TSK-10001 or CTK-10001) recorded on reward credits.

taskName.description: Task name recorded on task_reward and custom_task_reward entries.

submissionId.description: Explicit submissionId or customTaskId recorded on reward credits.

approvedAt.description: ISO approval timestamp recorded on reward credits.

WithdrawalRequest.title: WithdrawalRequest
WithdrawalRequest.description: Member payout request with mandatory fixed 5 BDT fee breakdown.

accountNumber.description: Destination bKash or Nagad mobile wallet number.

netAmount.description: Net received payout (grossAmount - 5 BDT, minimum 95 BDT).

paymentReference.description: External bKash/Nagad TrxID recorded when marked Paid.

processedBy.description: Main Admin UID who processed the withdrawal.

PasswordChangeRequest.title: PasswordChangeRequest
PasswordChangeRequest.description: Zero-plaintext password change authorization request submitted by a member.

reason.description: Reason for requesting password change authorization (never contains passwords).

decisionNote.description: Main Admin approval or rejection note.

reviewedBy.description: Main Admin UID who decided on the request.

reviewedAt.description: ISO timestamp of Main Admin decision.

AdminAuditLog.title: AdminAuditLog
AdminAuditLog.description: Immutable administrative audit trail recording all privileged Main Admin and Assistant Admin actions.

adminUid.description: UID of the acting Main Admin or Assistant Admin.

adminEmail.description: Email of the acting Main Admin or Assistant Admin.

targetId.description: Document ID of the affected record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the administrative action.

MonthlyMemberEarning.title: MonthlyMemberEarning
MonthlyMemberEarning.description: Public-safe, non-PII monthly eligible earnings projection for a member in an Asia/Dhaka (UTC+6) calendar month.

displayName.description: Public display name of the member.

photoAssetId.description: Optional avatar mediaAsset ID, or empty string.

isEligibleMember.description: Whether the account is an approved eligible member.

eligibleEarnings.description: Net approved eligible task earnings in BDT during this calendar month.

approvedTaskCount.description: Count of valid approved task credits during this calendar month.

reachedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when the member reached their current monthly eligible total (used for tie-breaking).

lastTransactionId.description: Most recent applied transaction ID or sync marker.

lastSubmissionId.description: Submission ID used for atomic Assistant Admin single-credit verification, or empty string.

LeaderboardRankRewardConfig.title: LeaderboardRankRewardConfig
LeaderboardRankRewardConfig.description: Prize configuration for a single Best 10 rank position (1st to 10th).

prizeTitle.description: Prize title configured by Main Admin.

monetaryValue.description: Optional monetary value in BDT (0 if non-cash or unspecified).

enabled.description: Whether a prize is enabled for this rank.

LeaderboardPeriod.title: LeaderboardPeriod
LeaderboardPeriod.description: Monthly Best 10 period metadata, reward configuration for positions 1-10, publication toggle, and finalization state.

rewardsPublished.description: Whether configured monthly rewards are visible to members.

rewards.description: Ordered 10-slot reward configurations for positions 1 to 10.

finalizedAt.description: ISO timestamp when finalized by Main Admin, or empty string.

finalizedBy.description: Main Admin UID who finalized the month, or empty string.

lastSyncedAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent ledger sync.

LeaderboardWinner.title: LeaderboardWinner
LeaderboardWinner.description: Archived finalized Best 10 monthly winner record (zero PII).

photoAssetId.description: Winner avatar MediaAsset ID or empty string.

eligibleEarnings.description: Finalized monthly eligible earnings in BDT.

reachedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when final eligible total was reached.

monetaryValue.description: Assigned optional monetary prize value in BDT.

deliveredAt.description: Delivery timestamp/date recorded by Main Admin, or empty string.

LeaderboardWinnerAdminMeta.title: LeaderboardWinnerAdminMeta
LeaderboardWinnerAdminMeta.description: Main Admin-exclusive private fulfillment notes and member code reference for finalized Best 10 winners.

updatedBy.description: Main Admin UID who last updated delivery metadata.

/assistantAdmins/{assistantId}.description: Authoritative RBAC Assistant Admin registry managed exclusively by Main Admin.

/users/{userId}.description: Private member, assistant admin, and main admin profiles with registration approval states.

/mediaAssets/{assetId}.description: Isolated compressed image storage for avatars and proof screenshots.

/tasks/{taskId}.description: Main Admin-managed official freelancing tasks with predefined BDT reward amounts.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Member proof screenshot submissions for official tasks and Admin/Assistant Admin review outcomes.

/customTasks/{customTaskId}.description: Member custom task requests with Assistant Admin pre-review and Main Admin final payment approval.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Member decision notifications for custom and official task reviews.

/wallets/{userId}.description: Atomic member wallets storing available balance, earnings, withdrawals, and fees.

/transactions/{transactionId}.description: Immutable ledger history of official rewards, custom task rewards, reversals, withdrawal deductions, payouts, and refunds.

/withdrawals/{withdrawalId}.description: Member bKash and Nagad withdrawal requests with fixed 5 BDT fee breakdown.

/passwordChangeRequests/{requestId}.description: Main Admin-reviewed password change authorization requests containing zero password data.

/adminAuditLogs/{logId}.description: Append-only audit log of all privileged Main Admin and Assistant Admin operations.

/monthlyMemberEarnings/{entryId}.description: Public-safe, non-PII monthly eligible earnings tallies per member in Asia/Dhaka (UTC+6).

/leaderboardPeriods/{monthKey}.description: Monthly Best 10 reward configurations, publication state, and finalization lock.

/leaderboardWinners/{winnerId}.description: Archived finalized Best 10 monthly winner records (positions 1-10, zero PII).

/leaderboardAdminNotes/{winnerId}.description: Main Admin-exclusive private delivery notes and member code records for Best 10 winners.
